violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -Bare wood shelves and in the back storage area.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Vent hood in need of cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Dust on the ceiling in the kitchen area.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not maintained in good repair. -Ceiling tiles in the kitchen around the vent hood have gaps in them. Missing ceiling tiles in the back storage room exposing the attic.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. The edges of the white shelves around the microwave and in the stockroom are bare wood. Wooden shelves in the back stockroom are bare wood. These are not a cleanable surface.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Missing handle on the upright freezer in the back stockroom with exposed insulation.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Foam containers on the shelf below the pop system and paper boats on the shelves in the middle stockroom were not inverted.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors under the fryers by the black stove need to be cleaned.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Missing, holes, and torn flooring in the kitchen and dish area. Broken and missing floor tile by the back door, walk in cooler, and chest freezers.
